dct_description_sm: Dataset contains daily measurements of ammonia volatilization (NH3) from various nitrogen fertilizer sources. Measurements were made with three methods: the wind tunnel method, the Dosi-Tube method (old equation) and an updated Dosi-Tube equation that was published in the related paper in the Canadian Journal of Soil Science (Kang et al. 2024). Also in the dataset is daily wind speed measurements taken at the same time as volatilization measurements, as daily wind speed is used in the Dosi-Tube method.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: A simple and accurate Dosi-Tube method for estimating ammonia loss from in-season nitrogen application in corn fields
